morphogenesis.name: Morphogenesis: Pattern from Noise
morphogenesis.truth: You don't need a blueprint. Random initial conditions + simple rules = complex patterns.
morphogenesis.qfep_connection: Turing morphogenesis is the E(S) term creating F—entropy generating order through self-organization. Diffusion (entropy-increasing) paradoxically creates structure when coupled with local activation.
morphogenesis.description: Turing's 1952 insight: ordered patterns emerge from homogeneous chaos. Reaction-diffusion dynamics, edge of chaos, spontaneous self-organization. The generative engine where entropy becomes structure.
